title: Request storage
purpose: Explain how a request reaches in-memory storage.

router.label: Request handler
router.summary: Receives a task and calls storage.
router.details: Accepts the request and awaits the storage function.

store.label: Storage function
store.details: Writes the task to the process-local Map.

map.label: Write to Map
map.details: A write replaces the previous task with the same identifier.

done.label: Task stored
done.details: The write completed. Data lasts for the current process lifetime.
